standard.summary: enable_inference_accel 为训练中的采样预览启用 lulynx 推理加速工程路径；缓存后端可能受 SmoothCache 等研究启发，但不承诺论文等价。
standard.effect: enable_inference_accel 开启后预览生成速度提升约 1.3~1.6×；enable_base_weight 允许训练带有基础权重偏置的 LoRA；enable_block_weights 开启 block 级 LR 权重；enable_distributed_training 开启多卡训练（需要多 GPU 环境）。
standard.whenToUse: 各字段视需求开启，大多数有对应的细粒度配置参数。enable_sequential_cpu_offload 是最激进的 offload（逐层），仅在极端低 VRAM 时使用。
standard.avoidWhen: enable_distributed_training 需要多 GPU 环境且正确配置 DDP；enable_sequential_cpu_offload 极大降低训练速度，只作为 OOM 最后手段。

standard_en.summary: enable_inference_accel turns on the lulynx inference acceleration path for the sampling previews taken during training; the cache backend may draw inspiration from research such as SmoothCache but claims no equivalence to any paper.
standard_en.effect: With enable_inference_accel on, preview generation runs roughly 1.3-1.6x faster; enable_base_weight allows training a LoRA carrying a base weight bias; enable_block_weights turns on block-level LR weights; enable_distributed_training turns on multi-GPU training (which needs a multi-GPU environment).
standard_en.whenToUse: Turn each on as needed -- most have their own finer-grained configuration parameters. enable_sequential_cpu_offload is the most aggressive offload (layer by layer) and is for extremely low VRAM only.
standard_en.avoidWhen: enable_distributed_training needs a multi-GPU environment with DDP configured correctly; enable_sequential_cpu_offload slows training enormously and is a last resort against OOM.

advanced.principle: 这些开关字段通常控制对应功能模块的激活状态。enable_* 设为 false 时，对应模块的所有子参数即使设置也不生效。
advanced.tradeoffs: 顶层开关使功能的启用/禁用更方便，但需要注意开关与子参数的组合：开关 off 但子参数有值时，子参数静默不生效（无警告）。

advanced_en.principle: These switch fields usually control whether the corresponding feature module is active. When enable_* is false, all sub-parameters of that module are inert even if set.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Top-level switches make enabling/disabling convenient, but watch the switch × sub-parameter combination: switch off with sub-parameters set means the sub-parameters are silently inert (no warning).
